broker.name: FP Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2005. Its site names 5 regulators, including ASIC, CySEC, and FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: FP Markets says it has operated since 2005. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Raw. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader, TradingView, Iress, and Mottai. The site names these regulators: ASIC, CySEC, FSCA, FSA (Seychelles), and CMA (Kenya). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. ASIC: First Prudential Markets Pty Ltd, 286354. CySEC: First Prudential Markets Ltd, 371/18. FSCA: 50926. FSA (Seychelles): First Prudential Markets Limited, SD130. CMA (Kenya): 193.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage loaded. It says FP Markets was founded in 2005 in Sydney, Australia. The ASIC Financial Services Guide gives a Sydney street address for First Prudential Markets Pty Ltd. The site also gives a Saint Lucia registered office for FP Markets Ltd and does not call either address the group headquarters, so headquarters is null. Saint Lucia registration is not listed as a regulator. The group page names FSCA FSP 50926 and Kenya CMA licence 193 without entity names. CySEC 371/18 and Seychelles FSA SD130 entity names come from the Saint Lucia client agreement. The UK regulation page names CySEC, FSCA and the Seychelles FSA without numbers. Iress and Mottai appear on the Australia account page.
